title: HB1529 (2019 Regular): Veterans' exemptions for concealed firearms; authorize certain photo-id as verification of disability.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2019/html/HB/1500-1599/HB1529IN.htm)
provenance.note: As-filed text. Only subsection (23) is changed; the rest of § 45-9-101 is existing law and not quoted. No passage vote.

operative_text: Section 1 (Miss. Code § 45-9-101): (23) A disabled veteran who seeks to qualify for an exemption under this section shall be required to provide, as proof of service-connected disability, verification from the United States Department of Veterans Affairs. A veterans health identification card that shows that the veteran's disability is service-connected shall be considered proof of service-connected disability for purposes of meeting the requirements of this subsection.
